A '''gas giant''' was located in the [[Sartinaynian system]], and creatures similar to [[Beldon/Legends|beldons]] lived in its [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. The [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] also had numerous [[Moon/Legends|moons]]. In [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]], during the events of the [[Battle of Bastion]], [[Yuuzhan Vong]] and [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] elements clashed above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], with the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] ''[[Superior]]'' and [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']] among them. There, the ''Superior'' was destroyed, and the ''Chimaera'' was heavily damaged.
